_comment: ChoZen one-idea-to-five-platforms working file. Copy, fill, work top to bottom. The core block is written once; each platform block is written SEPARATELY from the core, never copied from another platform.

core.idea: One plain sentence. The thing you actually want to say.

scripture.precept: The one-line principle drawn out of the verse.
cross_references: Verify each of these actually echoes the main verse before using.

product_tie.item: At most one. Leave empty if it would be forced.
product_tie._note: The 'line' field drives the Brand Law check. Athletic/windbreaker carries NO fringes.

core.ask: The one action a person should take.

source_files: local path(s) — must exist before scheduling
postiz_uploaded_urls: filled in after `postiz upload` — required for IG/TikTok/YouTube
media.brand_law_notes: If BLOCKED, exactly what failed and what fixes it.

instagram.hook_125: The first 125 characters. This is the whole game.
instagram.caption: Hook, then short paragraphs with real line breaks.
instagram.first_comment_hashtags: 8-15 tags, tiered broad/mid/narrow. NOT in the caption.
instagram.alt_text: Describe the garment including fringes and ribband.

tiktok.caption: 100-150 characters. Short. The hook is in the video.
tiktok.video_hook_2s: What literally happens in the first two seconds.
tiktok.spoken_cta: The CTA said out loud in the video.

facebook.caption: 200-500 words. Long is fine here. This is the warm audience — full testimony belongs here.
facebook.link: Facebook is the one network where a product link earns its place.

threads.caption: Under 500 characters. One thought. No polish — Threads punishes polish.
thread_replies: Optional. Each part must stand alone.

youtube.title: 60 chars. Front-load the searchable term.
youtube.description: First 150 chars show in search. Then 200+ words, timestamps, links at the bottom.
youtube.thumbnail: local path — must read at phone size

scheduled.notes: Report anything the guard or Brand Law moved, with the reason.
